mechanism: Paroxetine inhibits CYP2D6, which metabolizes atomoxetine, increasing atomoxetine plasma concentrations and noradrenergic effects; both drugs increase norepinephrine activity creating additive sympathomimetic effects.
action: Monitor for increased atomoxetine adverse effects (tachycardia, hypertension, tremor); consider dose reduction of atomoxetine or use alternative SNRI/SSRI with lesser CYP2D6 inhibition if possible.
